_comment: AOT images of what the app's users run most: Java and Maven (libjvm.so), Kimi Code (node),
Claude Code (claude.exe, Bun) and musl under all of them, and what their sessions run most:
bash and python3 (their workloads 2.3 and 4.2 times faster with the images; git's was no
faster, so it has none). Recorded by record_app_images.sh on the root the app ships, with the
packages below at the versions apk and npm give that day: an image serves the module it was
recorded from (its ELF build-id), so record again after the app's root or those packages
change (Claude Code updates itself often). node is recorded in the mode the app runs it in
